content:
I once asked who was responsible for the RFQ package.

I looked for the person who ensures the BOM matches the drawing and the spec matches the cert.
I usually found a gap.

Engineers focus on design. Sourcing managers focus on cost and timelines.
Neither is the "package person".

I used to think this was a personnel problem. I realized it was structural.
I noticed no one is hired to "assemble the package".

I watched a team where the person negotiating the contract was the same person assembling the files.
I saw the work move to the vendor.
The vendor becomes the project manager for the buyer.

I found that the solution is ownership. Someone has to assemble the organized package.

You can identify the same gap in your own company. If you do not have a dedicated owner for that step, your vendor does it by default.

Who in your company actually assembles the RFQ package before it goes out?
